name: Pedal to the Metal 2

origin.summary: An event from the 2015 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: A companion event to Pedal to the Metal 1, swapping in parallette handstand push-ups and a heavy kettlebell deadlift for the pegboard and dumbbell snatch.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2015/13 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-09; the final individual event of the 2015 Games, contested immediately after Pedal to the Metal 1
